title: Work Queue Task
description: One line of a queue.jsonl file. Each line is one task object that the run-queue skill executes and verifies on its own, with no human in the loop unless it gets quarantined.

id.description: Short unique task id. Used as the file name for its blocker file if it gets quarantined.

description.description: What the task does, in plain English. This is not proof of done. Only the verify step is proof.

execute_notes.description: Optional hints for how to do the work: files to touch, commands to run, gotchas. Not required.

verify.description: The one and only source of truth for whether this task is done. Narration of the work is never enough.

command.description: A shell command run from the repo root. Exit code 0 means verified. Any other exit code means not verified.

check.description: A written check a human can follow to confirm the task by hand. Used only when no shell command can prove the result (UI-only changes, third-party dashboards, physical checks). A manual task cannot be auto-verified, so it always needs a human before it can move to verified.

max_attempts.description: How many distinct approaches to try before quarantining. Default 2.

blast_radius.description: READ: looks at things, changes nothing. WRITE: changes files, dev data, or non-prod state. PROD_WRITE: changes production data, a live customer record, or anything a real customer or Naldo's business depends on right now.

depends_on.description: Ids of tasks that must be VERIFIED before this one starts.

status.description: Current state of the task. The queue file starts every task as pending; run-queue updates this field as it works.
